messages:
infra-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: spike in GPU Xid errors (Xid 13) across gpu-pool-3 starting 1709123420. Error rate ~4x baseline. Auto-evac triggered for affected hosts.
priya (oncall): Seeing driver resets + container restarts on host gpu-3-14. Is customer impact visible?
ben: Checking metrics — serving-runtime logs show repeated `E: GPU Xid 13` and `nv-host reset` around same time. KV-cache OOM spikes on long-context requests.
marco: Can we confirm if this is thermal / hardware ECC vs driver bug? Any recent driver updates rolled?
liam: No driver rollouts in the last 24h. Host kernel logs show CORRECTABLE ECC reports prior to Xid. Possible gradual parity issue.
natasha (customer-ops): Support ticket #RWI-9043 reporting increased 503s for /v1/generate. Customers on Dedicated also reported latency. 
priya (oncall): Triage plan: 1) Stop scheduling new requests to affected hosts, 2) Live-migrate in-flight sessions where possible, 3) Pull failing containers and rotate nodes. Agree?
ben: +1. I'll add a temporary route rule in Redwood Console to prefer region-us-west-2 fallback pool for traffic that hits model 'redwood-alpha'.
marco: If it's ECC-driven, we should cordon hosts and run memtest/firmware checks. But first immediate mitigation: reduce max-seq on long requests to avoid KV-cache OOM and force shorter allocations.
liam: Command to cordon: `sudo /opt/redwood/bin/nodectl cordon gpu-3-14 --reason \"Xid spike\"`
priya (oncall): I cordoned gpu-3-14 and gpu-3-15. Draining now. `nodectl drain --fast` in progress.
deploy-bot: rollback job detected for kernel-modules on fleet-gpu at 1709123502. No automated rollout triggered.
ben: I've added a fallback policy: requests that exceed 4096 tokens get routed to quantized-variant-qa which has lower memory footprint. This should cut OOM occurrences.
natasha (customer-ops): Notifying major impacted customers and giving ETA ~20-30m for routing stabilization.
marco: Any sign of correlated NVidia driver panic like `gpu fatal` in dmesg?
liam: dmesg snippet: ```[68723.123456] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:03:00): 13, PID=24567, GPU=dcer0``` and repeated `NVRM: GPU at 0000:03:00: Resetting GPU...`
priya (oncall): Good to know. Ben — can you throttle batch sizes on the high-latency routes as another quick fix?
ben: Done. Reduced batch size from 64->16 on the hot routes and enabled aggressive KV-cache eviction. Telemetry should show effect within 2 mins.
marco: If resets continue after cordon/drain, escalate to hardware replacement. Triage checklist: collect `nvidia-smi -q`, full dmesg, kernel oops logs, and capture microcode/BIOS versions.
liam: Kicking off `fleet-scan` to capture specs and SMC logs.
priya (oncall): Update: traffic redirected, error-rate dropping from 4x -> ~1.2x. Some models still see retries.
natasha (customer-ops): Customers updated: some experienced 10-15% request failure rate during the spike window. We're offering a post-mortem and status update.
ben: Telemetry shows KV-cache evictions fell 70% after batch throttle. No further container crashes on drained hosts.
marco: Action items: schedule hardware diag for gpu-3-14/15, create runbook entry for Xid-13 ECC pattern, add automatic cordon threshold to incident bot, and follow up with NVidia support if hardware diag finds parity errors.
priya (oncall): I'll own the follow-ups. Assigning: marco -> runbook & NVidia contact, liam -> hardware diag & results, ben -> routing + config persisting, natasha -> customer comms.
deploy-bot: Incident note appended to build:incident-log with tags [xid-13,ecc,live-mitigations] at 1709123620.
priya (oncall): Wrapping up monitoring. If error-rate stays stable <1.5x for 30m, we'll close paging and start postmortem. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
marco: One more thing — let's add a Canary that limits long-context requests per host by UID to reduce KV-cache pressure moving forward.
ben: Filing a quick RFC for canary policy now.
liam: Hardware diag job scheduled; ETA 8h. I'll upload artifacts to the incident folder.
natasha (customer-ops): Closing loop with customers. Will attach timeline and mitigations in the status.
priya (oncall): Last check: logs look good, no new Xid. Leaving cordons in place until diag completes. I'll update status in 30m or on any regression.
